scope: Planning, source/contract inspection, remote dependency metadata and offline tests only. No adapter implementation, deployment, installation, download, GPU simulation or model request.
identified_gaps: Current shared environment does not have the required simulator stack or RLinf RoboDojo module.
RoboDojo package does not export the native_catalog factory required by the research Workbench.
Existing GPU suite runner has no RoboDojo target.
Existing scripted GPU helper contains NO_PROXY overrides; review and correct before reuse under the project networking rule.
Real simulator, observation/action geometry, resource compatibility and full CLI/Dashboard/Workbench chains require validation.
Toolkit.close unconditionally calls env.close, whose RPC handler sets the server shutdown event; borrowed-service lifetime requires correction and a regression test before rollout.

plan_amendment.requirement: All simulator research workbenches use the current LIBERO form, shared frontend, operations and record/result contracts. Robot differences are supplied by adapters.
must_deliver: metadata-driven task identity and scene/seed selection
consistent result and usage semantics with missing values preserved
per-environment memory and native control contracts
regression checklist for all five simulators
identified_frontend_gaps: setup.js uses profile.suites, numeric array task indices and special command construction.
Seed options are hardcoded with a UniVTAC-specific exception.
plan_amendment.implementation: not started; this amendment changes planning documentation only
plan_amendment.pr_policy: Stage commits/pushes on the development branch; create one PR after the complete adaptation and validation. Do not reopen PR #5 or create stage PRs.
